text.tspan: searchesType returns true when typeUpper is ALL or equals the section name
NEWS, VIDEO, WRITING, SOUNDTRACK and IMAGE then repeat the identical two-phase shape in that order

svg.text: GET /api/v1/search with q, type ALL, page 0 and size 10
query is q trimmed, typeUpper is type uppercased, pageable is PageRequest.of(page, size)
SELECT DISTINCT id over titles, descriptions, tags, keywords and topic names
SearchSection.empty(page, size) and the second query is skipped
SELECT p WHERE p.id IN the ids, scalar columns only
bare entities with no collection joins
reindex by id to restore the ordered page, then build one SearchItem each
snippet strips Tiptap tags, collapses whitespace and truncates at 200 characters
